These archives preserve the versioned upstream source and notices for the distributed copyleft components. The manifest records the exact commit and file checksum. PawnIO includes PawnPP at commit e64e4c37b2d8ba0d8ee57205faf8183aee12c438. Build instructions are in each archive's upstream README/project files. Extract outside the AURA checkout before editing/building, so unrelated upstream projects are not recursively compiled into Aura.csproj.
